question: Should workflow integrations use the existing typed plugin `session_end` lifecycle hook, or should OpenClaw add a separate internal `session:end` hook event?
rationale: Both surfaces can support completion automation, but adding an internal event expands the operator hook API while the plugin hook is already the typed lifecycle contract and VISION.md prefers plugin seams for optional integrations.

options.title: Bless plugin `session_end`
options.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion hook for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue after that decision is visible.

options.title: Approve internal `session:end`
options.body: Define a narrow internal hook payload and wire it consistently across reset, deletion, shutdown/restart, cron/webhook runs, subagent completion, and compaction.

options.title: Wait for linked PR review
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61675 is landed or closed, then reassess the remaining internal-hook gap.

recommendation.title: Bless plugin `session_end`
recommendation.body: Document typed plugin `session_end` as the supported completion hook for workflow integrations and close or retitle this issue after that decision is visible.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily a hook/plugin API-boundary decision, and this handle has the strongest current source and discussion signal for that boundary.
